angles.headline: What athletes get wrong buying art
angles.pitch: Avery advises celebrities, athletes and high-net-worth individuals on buying and investing in art, and can share the fame, money and outlandish-request stories from that work.

angles.headline: From the locker room to the gallery wall
angles.pitch: How Avery builds artist careers into brands (Alec Monopoly; early champion of Hebru Brantley and Jammie Holmes), framed as a parallel to athletes building personal brands after their playing days.
angles.builds_on: Toosii and NIL-era 'I Am Next' episodes on athlete branding.

angles.headline: Miami's art-and-sports crossover
angles.pitch: A Miami art dealer on Art Basel Miami Beach deals (placing a $100K+ Hap Tivey work with Kris Jenner in 2024) and his City Seats program with the New York Yankees for the Boys & Girls Clubs of America.
angles.builds_on: I Am Athlete's Miami base and past Miami guests (e.g. David Grutman, per earlier research).
